title: University Ahmed Draia of Adrar
description: Official institutional portal of the University of Adrar, Algeria, supporting higher education, doctoral faculties, and scientific research in the Algerian Sahara.

title: Platform of Algerian Manuscripts in Africa (PAM)
description: The landmark digital gateway preserving, cataloging, and showcasing historic Algerian and Saharan manuscript collections in West Africa.

title: West African Research Association (WARA)
description: Based at Boston University, WARA fosters collaborative research and scholarly exchange between scholars in West Africa and North America. Prof. Abbou is a Lifetime Member.

title: Algerian Scientific Journal Platform (ASJP)
description: The national publishing platform for peer-reviewed Algerian scientific journals, hosted by CERIST, featuring articles published in Rufuf and other classified journals.

title: Intensive Languages Teaching Centre (CEIL)
description: Center dedicated to accelerated language acquisition in English, French, Spanish, and Turkish for academics, doctoral researchers, and professionals.

title: West African Arabic Manuscript Database (WAAMD)
description: A collaborative international database hosted by UC Berkeley documenting Arabic manuscript collections throughout West Africa.

title: Mirath Tuat (ميراث توات)
description: Dedicated cultural and historical repository honoring the heritage, scholars, and manuscript traditions of the Tuat oasis region.
